zh-CN.name: 极简与瑞士风格
zh-CN.description: 组合检索标签：极简强调减少无关元素，瑞士风格强调清晰栅格、无衬线排印与信息秩序。两者可以结合，但不属于同一个定义完全相同的流派。
use_when: 文本和信息层级比装饰更重要。
需要建立一致的排版与对齐关系。
avoid_when: 不要把极简变成隐藏重要操作或帮助。
品牌需要丰富叙事时，可保留必要的图像与情绪。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 删去重复装饰，按明确栅格对齐标题、正文与操作；用字体大小、字重和留白区分层级，保留可见的操作提示；不要用极低对比度表达克制。

en.name: Minimalism & Swiss Style
en.description: A combined search label: minimalism removes nonessential elements, while Swiss style emphasizes structured grids, clear typography and visual order. They can work together but are not identical design traditions.
use_when: Typography and information hierarchy matter more than decoration.
The product needs a consistent alignment and spacing system.
avoid_when: Do not hide essential actions or help in the name of minimalism.
Retain meaningful imagery when the brand needs a richer narrative.
en.prompt_template: Remove redundant decoration and align headings, body text and actions to a clear grid. Use type size, weight and whitespace for hierarchy, retain visible interaction cues, and keep restrained styling legible.
